about: Go geodata API over Postgres, goose migrations, a tile cache on disk

rules.text: Never force-push the main branch
The tile cache under var/cache/tiles/ is rebuilt by the cron job, never cleared by hand
A commit subject begins with its ticket key, ATL-123 style
Keep the API token file token.secret out of git
Never run goose down against the shared staging database

about: Rails SaaS app deployed with Capistrano, GraphQL schema generated from types

rules.text: Deploys to production happen from the deploy workflow only, never from a laptop with cap production deploy
config/master.key is never committed or printed
Commits carry one human author: no Co-Authored-By, Signed-off-by or other trailers
Don't drop tables in a migration; mark them deprecated first
Never edit the generated files under app/graphql/schema/

about: Python data pipeline with dbt over a warehouse, landing files loaded by a loader job

rules.text: Nothing under warehouse/exports/ is ever committed; it holds customer data
The production warehouse is never queried from a notebook or a shell; use the dbt target dev
Packages come from requirements.lock alone; never pip install anything else
Signed-off-by lines are required on every commit (git commit -s)
Never delete files under data/landing/ by hand; the loader owns them

about: TypeScript monorepo: a React app, a Fastify API and published packages

rules.text: Publishing packages is the release workflow's job; never run npm publish from a terminal
Feature branches are rebased onto main before merging; never merge main into a feature branch
Never add eslint-disable comments
The playwright tests in apps/web/e2e/ are never skipped with test.skip or .only
Commit messages name the package they change in brackets, like [web] or [api]

about: Elixir/Phoenix chat service with Terraform infrastructure in infra/

rules.text: Never run mix ecto.reset against anything but the local database
The prod Terraform workspace is applied by CI only; never terraform apply it from a laptop
Secrets live in Vault; never write a token or password into config/*.exs
Never delete a tag that has been pushed to origin
Every commit message ends with a Ticket: RLY-<n> footer line
